sections.text: An independent commission found Manchester City guilty of breaching Premier League financial regulations between the 2009-10 and 2017-18 seasons by artificially inflating revenue through sponsorship agreements. City plan to appeal and will argue that funds came from the Abu Dhabi government rather than their owners.

sections.heading: Why it matters

gist: England avoided Australia and India in the 2027 Cricket World Cup group draw.
India and Pakistan were placed into the same group for the tournament.
England will travel to Zimbabwe for a match for the first time since 2004.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: The group-stage draw for the tournament placed England alongside South Africa, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, New Zealand and a qualifier. India and Pakistan were grouped together with Australia, Afghanistan, Zimbabwe and another qualifier. England will start their matches against Bangladesh, followed by fixtures involving Sri Lanka, South Africa, a qualifier, and New Zealand.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: England avoided top-ranked opponents in their group stage. Their upcoming match in Zimbabwe is notable because the team has not played a fixture there since 2004, following political issues and a boycott during the 2003 World Cup.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: The group stage begins when India play Australia in Cape Town on 7 October. The top three teams and the best fourth-placed team from each group advance to the Super 7 stage, leading to semi-finals in November and the final in Johannesburg on 21 November.

fivew: England's men's team and other international cricket sides are involved.
The tournament matches are scheduled for October and November.
Matches will take place in locations including South Africa, Zimbabwe and Namibia.

gist: Mason Crane is recalled to England's squad for the Pakistan tri-series.
Jofra Archer is rested while Jos Buttler is out injured.
Uncapped pair James Coles and Henry Crocombe are included.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Mason Crane has been recalled for England's upcoming one-day international tri-series in Pakistan. Sam Curran and Adil Rashid return from injuries, while uncapped players James Coles and Henry Crocombe join the squad. Jofra Archer is rested, and Jos Buttler misses out due to a hamstring injury.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: The series forms part of England's white-ball schedule as they build up to the 50-over World Cup. Crane also has an opportunity to push his case to be England's number one spinner in Test cricket.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: England will play in the tri-series in Pakistan, which also involves Sri Lanka, ahead of further fixtures in Australia and South Africa.

fivew: England are building up to the 50-over World Cup and rotating their squad and coaching staff.
